title: Reactive Music - Mario Kart
description: Reactive Music Songpack adding music from Mario Kart World's Free Roam
body:
![Banner art for Mario Kart World](https://image-assets.m.nintendo.com/19a37fd2-038e-4bb6-bc63-31be3d734746?im=Resize,height=640)

## DISCLAIMER: Due to the file size limit on resource packs, updates for this songpack will no longer be released on Modrinth. Future updates can be found in the `songpack-releases` forum channel in Reactive Music's [Discord server](https://discord.gg/vJ6BCjPR3R).

## This pack requires the [Reactive Music](https://modrinth.com/mod/reactive-music) mod by CircuitLord

This songpack adds music from the Mario Kart series. It includes 44 tracks from across the series, plus an additional 3 bonus tracks.

## HOW TO INSTALL/USE
- Install the [Reactive Music](https://modrinth.com/mod/reactive-music) mod to your Minecraft installation. If you are using a version of Reactive Music that requires [YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl), make sure it's also installed.
- Add the songpack to your game's Resource Pack folder. (No need to enable it)
- Open Reactive Music's settings through the Mods menu on the title screen or by using the `/reactivemusic` command when in a world
- Select the Mario Kart World Free Roam songpack from the list
